name: Lesnaya pesnya
source:
Semyon Persunov has been in the mysterious Sovyonok pioneer camp for four days now. And today he is truly having a "good morning." His good mood and the friendliness of the surrounding world inspire the gloomy bitard to pluck some strings. He heads to the music club for a guitar. However, the newly minted pioneer could not even imagine how this seemingly innocent activity might turn out.

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2695332558]Steam[/url]]
translation:
谢苗·佩尔苏诺夫已经在神秘的苏维约诺克先锋营地待了四天了。今天他确实度过了一个“早上好”。他的好心情和周围世界的友善激发了这个阴沉的比特币拨动一些琴弦。他去音乐俱乐部买吉他。然而，这位新晋拓荒者甚至无法想象这种看似无辜的活动可能会变成什么样子。

[译自[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2695332558]Steam[/url]]
